title: OBD-II Configuration
description: Scan one or more vehicles with OBD-II (SAE J1979, J1979-2 OBDonUDS) on CAN (ISO 15765-4) or DoIP. Every action transmits on the vehicle's bus.

vehicles.title: Vehicles
vehicles.description: One entry per vehicle (one CAN bus or DoIP entity), or use Auto-configure for a demo vehicle.

interface.title: Interface
interface.description: How the extension reaches the vehicle: SocketCAN (Linux), SocketCAN over SSH (a remote Linux device's SocketCAN, from any OS), PCAN, Kvaser, Vector, slcan, or Other (any python-can interface, e.g. gs_usb). Demo: a built-in simulated vehicle with three ECUs. DoIP: OBD-II over TCP/IP (ISO 13400) to the vehicle's DoIP entity. The bus opens when the extension starts.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name the actions take as `vehicle` and the trace shows. Letters, digits, space, '_' and '-' only. Defaults to the CAN channel, sanitized, 'demo' or 'doip'.

addressing.title: Addressing
addressing.description: ISO 15765-4 identifiers: 11-bit (0x7DF, answers on 0x7E8-0x7EF) or 29-bit (0x18DB33F1, answers on 0x18DAF1xx). Detect finds it. Not used over DoIP.

protocol.title: Protocol
protocol.description: auto: ask 01 00, and 22 F400 if nothing answers. legacy: SAE J1979 services 01-0A. uds: SAE J1979-2 (OBDonUDS, MY2027+ US light duty).

polling.title: Polling
polling.description: PIDs read from the start at a fixed period, into the trace. Transmits for as long as the extension runs.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: SocketCAN interface name (can0, vcan0, slcan0, ...). Choose from the interfaces on the machine running the agent, or type a name.

config_json.title: Advanced Configuration (JSON)
config_json.description: Additional python-can Bus() kwargs as JSON object

remote_host.title: Remote Host
remote_host.description: Hostname or IP of the edge device running SocketCAN, reached over SSH (may be a ~/.ssh/config alias)

remote_channel.title: Remote CAN Channel
remote_channel.description: SocketCAN interface name on the remote edge device (e.g. can0, vcan0)

ssh_user.title: SSH User
ssh_user.description: Username for the SSH connection (optional; falls back to your ssh config / current user)

ssh_port.title: SSH Port
ssh_port.description: TCP port for the SSH connection

ssh_key_path.title: SSH Key File
ssh_key_path.description: Path to a private key file for SSH authentication (optional)

ssh_host_key_policy.title: SSH Host Key Policy
ssh_host_key_policy.description: How to treat the edge's SSH host key. 'auto' trusts whatever key the device presents and records nothing, so a reimaged device (which comes back with a new key) reconnects with no manual step. 'strict' uses your own ~/.ssh/known_hosts: an unknown or changed key is reported and the bus stops, rather than retrying.

ssh_extra_opts.title: SSH Extra Options
ssh_extra_opts.description: Additional ssh command-line options, space-separated (e.g. -J bastion). Placed before the options above; ssh honours the first -o it sees, so these win over the settings above.

ssh_hw_timestamps.title: Hardware timestamps
ssh_hw_timestamps.description: Uses the adapter's hardware clock when the edge's candump supports -H; interfaces without one (vcan, some slcan) fall back to the extension's wall clock. Turn off to use the edge kernel's receive time.

bitrate.title: Bitrate (bps)
bitrate.description: ISO 15765-4 bitrates: 500 kbit/s (legislated) or 250 kbit/s. Detect tries both.

config_json.description: Additional python-can Bus() kwargs as JSON object

channel.title: Serial Port
channel.description: Serial device of the slcan adapter: /dev/ttyACM0 (Linux), /dev/tty.usbmodem... (macOS), COM3 (Windows).

bitrate.title: Bitrate (bps)
bitrate.description: ISO 15765-4 bitrates: 500 kbit/s (legislated) or 250 kbit/s. Detect tries both.

config_json.title: Advanced Configuration (JSON)
config_json.description: Additional python-can slcan Bus() kwargs as JSON object, e.g. {"tty_baudrate": 115200} for a UART adapter

config_json.title: Advanced Configuration (JSON)
config_json.description: Provide complete python-can Bus() kwargs as JSON. Must include 'interface' and 'channel' keys. Example: {"interface": "ixxat", "channel": 0, "bitrate": 500000}

doip.title: DoIP

host.title: Host
host.description: IP address or hostname of the DoIP entity (the vehicle's gateway). Empty with Discover: found by a broadcast vehicle identification request, which exactly one entity must answer.

tester_address.title: Tester Logical Address
tester_address.description: The extension's own logical address (source address), hex. The entity must accept it in routing activation.

ecu_address.title: Target Address
ecu_address.description: Logical address requests go to, hex: 0xE400 the functional group (every ECU), or one ECU's address.

activation_type.title: Routing Activation Type
activation_type.description: Hex: 0x00 default, 0x01 WWH-OBD, 0xE0 central security, 0xE1 to 0xFF OEM-specific.

tcp_timeout.title: TCP Timeout (s)
tcp_timeout.description: Bounds the TCP connect and the entity's acknowledgement of each request.

discover.title: Discover
discover.description: Before connecting, send a vehicle identification request (UDP 13400) to Host, or broadcast without one. The answer (IP, logical address, VIN, EID) shows in Get Status.

doip.description: OBD-II over DoIP: requests go to the functional address and every ECU behind the entity answers from its logical address.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Settings that apply to every vehicle.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: Leading trace source every vehicle publishes under, so events read '<prefix>/<vehicle>/tx'. Clear it to give each vehicle its own trace source.

p2_timeout.title: Response Window (seconds)
p2_timeout.description: How long to wait for the first, and each further, ECU's answer to a request (ISO 15765-4 P2CAN is 0.05 s). Raise it over SSH or a slow DoIP gateway.

p2_star_timeout.title: P2* Timeout (seconds)
p2_star_timeout.description: How long to wait after each response-pending (NRC 0x78) answer.

isotp_padding.title: Padding Byte
isotp_padding.description: Byte every sent frame is padded to 8 bytes with (ISO 15765-4: DLC is always 8); 204 = 0xCC.

debug_frames.title: Debug Frames
debug_frames.description: Log every ISO-TP frame and DoIP message at DEBUG level.
